Legal Bot: Reminder: avoid absolute guarantees. Replace tildes with words like "about" or "typical" and include privacy line on gated form.

Riley (design-ops): Will swap to "typical". Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/mini-roi-pack, I'll drop frames under /marketing/launch. Export: PNG @2x, SVG, PPTX slide. Alt text + EN/FR ready.

Nina (marketing): Perfect 44d. Ping here when frames are in, will route to ops for routing slide.
